description.zh: 截图、标注、贴图、长截图、识别文字、录屏和演示白板
description.en: Screenshots, annotations, pins, long screenshots, text recognition, screen recording and a presentation whiteboard

notes.zh: 文字也能贴到屏幕：复制一段文字后按贴图快捷键，或者在剪贴板历史里的文字上按 F3（Win顺 0.38.0），文字做成一张卡片贴在屏幕上，换行、缩进照原样，代码用等宽字体，在卡片上按 Ctrl+C 复制的是原来的文字（#388）。权限不变。
notes.en: Words can be pinned on the screen too: the pin shortcut after copying some text, or F3 on a text in the clipboard history (WinShun 0.38.0), pins it as a card with its line breaks and indents, code in a monospaced font; Ctrl+C on the card copies the words themselves (#388). Permissions unchanged.
